title: Larkspur Valuables Floater Rate Manual: Class Rates per 100 USD
content:
Each item class on the Larkspur Valuables Floater carries its own annual rate, stated in US dollars of annual premium for every 100 USD of scheduled value in that class. The rate depends on the tier the floater is written on.

## Class rates, annual premium per 100 USD of scheduled value

| Item class | Classic | Select | Preferred | Prestige | Collector | Private Client |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jewelry | 1.42 | 1.36 | 1.29 | 1.22 | 1.16 | 1.08 |
| Watches | 1.18 | 1.13 | 1.08 | 1.02 | 0.97 | 0.91 |
| Fine art | 0.19 | 0.18 | 0.17 | 0.16 | 0.15 | 0.13 |
| Silverware | 0.31 | 0.30 | 0.28 | 0.27 | 0.26 | 0.24 |
| Furs | 0.58 | 0.56 | 0.53 | 0.51 | 0.49 | 0.46 |
| Cameras and optics | 1.64 | 1.58 | 1.51 | 1.45 | 1.39 | 1.32 |
| Musical instruments | 0.64 | 0.62 | 0.59 | 0.56 | 0.54 | 0.51 |
| Collectibles, stamps and coins | 0.48 | 0.46 | 0.44 | 0.42 | 0.40 | 0.37 |
| Wine | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.35 | 0.33 | 0.31 | 0.29 |

Tier columns are the Valuables Floater Classic, Select, Preferred, Prestige, Collector and Private Client.

## Reading the table

- A rate is always read from the column of the tier the floater is written on and the row of the item's class as recorded on the schedule.
- The rate is an annual figure per 100 USD of scheduled value, so 100 USD of jewelry on the Valuables Floater Select carries 1.36 USD of annual premium.
- A wine rate of 0.00 means the wine class is not offered on that tier. On the Valuables Floater Classic and Select the wine rate is 0.00.

## Rate lookup (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical schedule of 12000 USD of cameras on the Valuables Floater Select: 12000 USD is 120 hundreds, and 120 multiplied by the Select camera rate of 1.58 gives 189.60 USD of annual class premium. The same 12000 USD of cameras on the Valuables Floater Private Client, at 1.32, gives 158.40 USD.
